verses.text: My son, accept what I say, and store up my commands inside you.
Turn your ear to wisdom, and set your heart on understanding.
Call out for good judgment. Cry out loud for understanding.
Look for wisdom as you would look for silver. Search for it as you would search for hidden treasure.
Then you will understand what it means to respect the LORD, and you will find the knowledge of God.
The LORD gives wisdom. Knowledge and understanding come from his mouth.
He stores up sound wisdom for honest people. He is a shield to those who live without blame.
He guards the paths of those who are fair, and he protects the way of his faithful people.
Then you will understand what is right, fair, and honest, and every good path.
Wisdom will come into your heart, and knowledge will be pleasant to you.
Good sense will watch over you. Understanding will protect you.
Wisdom will save you from the ways of evil people, from people whose words are twisted,
who leave the straight paths to walk in dark ways,
who enjoy doing wrong and take delight in twisted evil,
whose paths are crooked and whose ways are dishonest.
Wisdom will save you from the woman who is unfaithful, from the woman who is a stranger, with her flattering words,
who has left the husband of her youth and forgotten the covenant she made before her God.
Her house leads down to death. Her paths lead to the spirits of the dead.
No one who goes to her comes back. They never reach the paths of life again.
So follow the ways of good people, and stay on the paths of those who do right.
Honest people will live in the land. Those who are blameless will stay in it.
But the wicked will be removed from the land. Those who are unfaithful will be pulled out of it.
